message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine TEMPO features a large, dark grey revolver occupying most of the frame. The handgun is angled diagonally from the upper left toward the bottom right. Its cylinder is swung open to the left, revealing several empty chambers. Tiny human figures interact with the weapon: one person in a white tank top is crawling out of a cylinder chamber; a second person in a reddish shirt and grey pants is kneeling on the frame, reaching toward an empty chamber; and a third person with a red headband, black vest, and light trousers stands on the rear grip, looking down.

The background is a solid off-white color with a red vertical border on the left. Red text at the top reads "TEMPO" with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below. Other legible black text includes "TEROR DI MARKAS KOMANDO," "BURSA BARU CALON PENANTANG JOKOWI," and "DR M DAN RAHASIA KEMENANGANNYA." Smaller text describes an incident at a detention center in Kelapa Dua, Depok. A barcode and date "14-20 MEI 2018" are at the bottom right.
